sections.label: 43-66-01. Definitions.
sections.text:
43-66-01. Definitions.
As used in this chapter:
1. &quot;Community health representative&quot; means an individual trained through the Indian
health service to provide community-based and medically guided health care, which
may include traditional native concepts.
2. &quot;Community health worker&quot; means an individual certified under this chapter to provide
preventative services.
3. &quot;Department&quot; means the department of health and human services.
4. &quot;Preventative services&quot; means services to prevent a disease, disability, or other health
condition or the progression of a disease, disability, or other health condition which are
provided to an individual:
a. With a chronic condition;
b. At risk for a chronic condition who is unable to self-manage the chronic condition;
or
c. With a documented barrier that affects the individual&#039;s health.

sections.label: 43-66-02. Title - Prohibition.
sections.text:
43-66-02. Title - Prohibition.
An individual may not use the title &quot;community health worker&quot; unless that individual is
certified as a community health worker under this chapter.

sections.label: 43-66-03. Certification.
sections.text:
43-66-03. Certification.
1. The department shall establish and implement a method for certifying community
health workers, including:
a. Community health representatives; and
b. Other qualified individuals.
2. In implementing this section, the department may:
a. Adopt rules;
b. Charge a fee for certification and recertification;
c. Contract with a third party; and
d. Require an applicant to meet education and experience requirements.
